silhouette.reason: Slab with two ring footings, draped team tarps over block piles, a standing banner, setting-out posts with string lines, a timber stack, mortar tub and wheelbarrow: reads as a building site. From FRONT/SIDE it is still a flat strip with three red boxes; the vertical interest is thin.
fixes: a gin-pole or sheer-legs over one footing (2.5-3 m) so the stage has a strong vertical from every view

proportions.reason: 17.1 x 19.0 x 3.5 m; block piles, timber stack (~0.8 m) and footings at true scale beside 1.8 m units.
fixes: the 10 m team triangle painted on the slab dominates the top view: halve it or make it a chalked outline

materials.reason: Timber stack is brown oak now, tarps are team red cloth, footings bone stone. The slab is a blotchy grey/black camouflage pattern (sheet TOP) that reads neither as concrete nor flagstone, and the giant team triangle is a flat saturated decal with no paint texture.
fixes: slab on a flagstone or rammed-earth strip with readable joints at true scale (site.ts)
team triangle as worn chalk/paint with value break-up and lower saturation

detail.reason: Tarps on piles, string lines between stakes, wheelbarrow, mortar tub, timber stack, block courses on the footings, steps. Tarps are boxes with folds rather than draped cloth; no tools on the slab.
fixes: tarp edges hanging down the pile sides with a sag (site.ts materials())
a shovel and a hod leaning on one pile

wear.reason: Slab mottling reads as dirt and there is a dusty band on the footings, but no mud at pile feet, no mortar splash, no tracks from the wheelbarrow.
fixes: mud and mortar splash round the pallets and the tub
wheel ruts from the barrow to the timber stack

technical.reason: QA PASS, tris 10.8k / 3.5k / 626, draws 2/2/2; one trim material + team slot, LOD2 well under 1k. Triangles mostly sit in the running-bond blocks and slates, where they show.
